entry.content:
# Source Title Summary Topics Link
1 TechAsia Replacing fashion photoshoots with AI With 20 enterprise pilots underway, Swapify is helping fast-fashion brands replace expensive photoshoots with an AI-generation pipeline. AI Read

SemiconductorLogistics Read
6 TechAsia HSBC plans Singapore AI hub, 100+ AI roles HSBC plans to develop AI talent by collaborating with Singapore's educational institutions and government. AI Read
